'''September 2001 Milford tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Milford, MA on 1 September 2001. [[Eric Hunter]] won it. It is known from Eric Hunter's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2913">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-09-02-milford-mad2913/ milford-ma], DeckTech (Eric "bounty22" Hunter, 2 September 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-09-02-milford-mad2913/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 1 September 2001
* '''Site:''' Milford, MA
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Coruscant]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Eric Hunter]]
